svg.title: stdx's Zstandard against its baselines, on Neoverse-N2
svg.desc: Zstandard decoding, in multiples of libzstd's speed: ahead on 10, level on 6, behind on 23 of 39 files; 0.92 to 1.10. Zstandard encoding: speed in multiples of libzstd's level 3, against compression ratio: 2 of stdx's 2 levels have a faster and smaller point: level 1 by libzstd 3; level 3 by libzstd 3.
svg.text: stdx's Zstandard against its baselines, on Neoverse-N2
One job of run 45895089065 at commit fdfbb70. The line at 1 is the baseline each panel's title names; the axis is logarithmic.
Zstandard decoding, in multiples of libzstd's speed
ahead on 10, level on 6, behind on 23 of 39 files; 0.92 to 1.10
Zstandard encoding: speed in multiples of libzstd's level 3, against compression ratio
2 of stdx's 2 levels have a faster and smaller point: level 1 by libzstd 3; level 3 by libzstd 3
The number beside a point is its level. Up is smaller output, and right is faster.
† the benchmark repeats this file of 256 KiB or less, so the branch predictor learns it (decision 45)
▲ marks a row 5% or more faster than at v0.3.0, past the noise of both, ▼ one that much slower, and a dashed line its value at v0.3.0.
